name: Ramakrushna/ ରାମକୃଷ୍ଣ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Writing under the byline Ramakrushna, this contributor appears in Kabita Live’s May 2023 edition with “ଆୟୁଷ”, an Odia meditation on the span of a life. Wedding guests, a daughter’s arrival, a father’s death and a son’s departure follow one another with startling speed. Years seem to pass within the movements of a single day.

The poem then moves beyond the family home into forests, rivers and an unfamiliar landscape of mortality. Roads, scenes and dreams end almost as soon as they are approached. Its final questions ask how much a person can know of the life unfolding around them—and whether another, unknown lifetime might lie beyond the one they have lived.
